name: Standard Chartered Rewards+ Credit Card
highlights: S$1= 10X Points on Foreign Currency Spend
S$1= 5X Points on Local Dining Spend
S$1= 1X Point on All Other Spend
10X Rewards Points per S$1 spent in foreign currency, including online spends

extra.summary: The Standard Chartered Rewards+ card shines for overseas spending, offering 10X points (4 miles equivalent) on foreign currency transactions – great for online shopping in USD or travel beyond Johor Bahru. Foodies also benefit with 5X points on local dining.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: S$50 OR 1% of principal / interest, fees & charges / overlimit amount / past due amount, whichever is higher

documents-required.SG Citizens or PRs:
Apply via MyInfo and prepare the following, 
1. Copy of Passport (6 months validity), and page with address displayed (where applicable), 
2. Copy of Employment Pass, 
3. Either one of the following: utility bill, tax bill, latest bank /credit card statement, rental agreement showing your address, latest mobile phone statement, letter from employer stating current address, government-issued document stating current address

our_takes.our-take: The Standard Chartered Rewards+ card shines for overseas spending, offering 10X points (4 miles equivalent) on foreign currency transactions – great for online shopping in USD or travel beyond Johor Bahru. Foodies also benefit with 5X points on local dining. A key consideration: the 20,000 points cap limits high spenders. While the first-year fee waiver and no minimum spend are pluses, factor in the 3.5% foreign transaction fee and dining exclusions (hotel restaurants) when maximizing rewards.
our_takes.good-for:
Young professionals who frequently dine out, seeking accelerated rewards on local dining experiences.
Individuals who make frequent online purchases in foreign currencies, maximizing rewards on international e-commerce transactions.
Cardholders looking to accumulate rewards points without minimum spend requirements and an initial year fee waiver.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Foreign currency rewards are capped; exceeding 20,000 points yearly limits your earning potential.
Local dining bonus points exclude hotel restaurants and certain supermarkets, reducing eligible transactions.
27.9% annual interest rate applies if you carry a balance, significantly increasing your debt.
